description: This PHP trait defines statistics tracking and logging functions for indexing operations within the SuiteCRM search index module, including counters for modules, records, fields, and removed records, as well as methods for reporting and resetting these statistics.

classes.name: IndexingStatisticsTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing statistics and logging functionalities for search indexing within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getRemovedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records removed during indexing.

methods.name: getIndexedRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records indexed.

methods.name: getIndexedFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of fields indexed.

methods.name: getIndexedModulesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of modules indexed.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Logs statistics about the indexing process, including elapsed time, counts, and estimated time for processing more records.

methods.name: resetCounts
methods.description: Resets all statistical counters to zero.
